name: Universal Payment Gateway Plugin
author: AEC Core Team
description: Credential-free payment orchestrator that discovers independently installed and configured gateway plugins, provides a unified gateway status and checkout selection layer, and leaves cash/bank-transfer reconciliation in the LMS ledger. Provider credentials belong only to their dedicated plugins.

settings_schema.label: Allowed installed gateway slugs (comma separated)
settings_schema.help: Only enabled, credential-configured gateway plugins can be offered. Provider secrets must be saved in each gateway plugin.
